# Furnisys

> Furnisys (Furniture Systems) is a brand of Fabtech India, Navi Mumbai. Tagline: Functional Furniture Systems. It designs, manufactures and installs modular, configurable furniture systems for industrial, technical and institutional workspaces, from a 22,000 sq. ft. manufacturing facility.

Contact: enquiry@furnisys.co | +91 70457 63012 | Fabtech India, EL-21, TTC Industrial Area, MIDC, Mahape, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra 400710

## Programs
- [LISTA](https://www.furnisys.co.in/programs#lista): modular industrial workstations and workbenches (Base, Ansys, Pro, Scitec), Link system (Uprighter, Workstand, Trolley, flow racks), Flexi system, base, mobile and tall cabinets.
- [Wall Control](https://www.furnisys.co.in/programs#wall-control): metal pegboard panels and accessories for wall-mounted tool and storage organisation.
- [Lockers](https://www.furnisys.co.in/programs#lockers): steel lockers in Knock Down and All Welded series, 1 to 9 tiers.

- [Industries](https://www.furnisys.co.in/industries): Manufacturing, Aerospace & Aviation, Automotive & Auto Services, Oil & Gas, Power Generation, Agriculture & Outdoor, Construction, Jobsite Solutions, Metalworking, Museums, Libraries & Archives, Tool Crib & Point of Use, Government, Military & Law Enforcement, Education & Training, Healthcare, Gems & Jewellery.
- [Case studies](https://www.furnisys.co.in/case-studies)
- [How we work](https://www.furnisys.co.in/how-we-work): consultancy (product configuration), 2D/3D space planning, manufacturing, installation, after-sales service; channel partner program.
